verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe multi-region capabilities explicitly aimed at 'running global applications' with survival goals and table locality that determine how data is optimized/placed relative to regions (docs-7, docs-16, docs-24, docs-31), directly supporting region-aware placement for latency. However, a community comment notes multi-region functionality can be disabled/gated depending on tier ('For me it was the multiple regions... Data residency is the whole point'), signaling real-world licensing caveats not reflected in the docs. Missing for 10: concrete walkthrough/benchmark showing reduced read latency per region, and clarity on which tiers/plans include full multi-region placement without restriction.
